restaurant.name: Samosa House
restaurant.address: 11510 W Washington Blvd, Culver City, CA 90232

menu.shortDesc: Crisp golden savories & fritters served with house-made tamarind & cilantro-mint chutneys.

items.name: Artisan Samosa
items.description: Our world-famous golden pyramid pastry hand-folded and stuffed with roasted cumin potatoes and sweet green peas. Served with sweet tamarind and spicy mint chutneys.

items.name: Spinach Pakora
items.description: Fresh baby spinach leaves tossed in spiced roasted besan batter and flash-fried to golden, airy perfection.

items.name: Cauliflower Pakora
items.description: Tender cauliflower florets seasoned with ajwain carom seeds, ground coriander, and turmeric, fried crisp.

items.name: Chili Pakora
items.description: Stuffed Anaheim peppers dipped in savory spiced chickpea flour batter and fried golden brown.

items.name: Dahi Wada
items.description: Velvety lentil dumplings soaked in chilled spiced artisan yogurt, garnished with roasted cumin, paprika, and contrasting chutneys.

items.name: Hara Bhara Kabab
items.description: Pan-seared emerald patties of fresh spinach, green peas, and potatoes studded with roasted cashew nuts.

items.name: Sabudana Wada
items.description: Traditional Maharashtrian tapioca pearl and roasted crushed peanut cakes with a crackling crisp exterior and tender center.

items.name: Steamed Dhokla
items.description: Traditional Gujarati steamed savory sponge made from naturally fermented chickpea flour, tempered with mustard seeds and curry leaves.

items.name: Khasta Dal Kachori
items.description: Flaky golden puffed pastry shell packed with slow-roasted yellow moong dal and aromatic whole spices.

menu.shortDesc: Iconic Mumbai street-side snacks bursting with sweet dates, tart tamarind, and zesty chili water.

items.name: Signature Samosa Chaat
items.description: Crushed warm artisan samosas drenched in simmering chana masala, chilled sweet yogurt, diced sweet red onions, fresh cilantro, tamarind reduction, and crunchy chickpea sev.

items.name: Bhel Puri
items.description: Mumbai Chowpatty classic: puffed rice, crushed crisp papri wafers, fine sev, diced boiled potatoes, and red onions tossed vigorously with sweet-and-sour date chutneys.

items.name: Papri Chaat
items.description: Crispy whole wheat crisps layered with spiced garbanzo beans, steamed potatoes, seasoned whipped yogurt, roasted ground cumin, and mint relish.

items.name: Pani Puri (Gol Gappa)
items.description: Delicate hollow crispy semolina spheres filled with seasoned potatoes and black chickpeas, ready to be filled with chilled, herbaceous spicy-tangy mint water.

items.name: Dahi Sev Puri
items.description: Puffed crisp puris overflowing with spiced potatoes, sprouted pulses, chilled sweet yogurt, date chutney, and a generous blizzard of crispy sev.

items.name: Aloo Tikki Chaat
items.description: Griddled golden potato medallions crowned with piping hot spiced chana masala, drizzled with yogurt and vibrant house chutneys.

items.name: Kachori Chaat
items.description: Flaky moong dal kachori gently crushed and layered with savory chickpea gravy, cooling whipped yogurt, diced onions, and cilantro.

menu.shortDesc: Generous thali combinations featuring daily simmering homestyle curries, fragrant basmati, and hot breads.

items.name: 3-Item Combo (White Basmati)
items.description: Your choice of any three hot curries or vegetable stews from our daily deli counter. Served with aged white basmati rice, fresh tandoori naan or whole-wheat roti, and house raita or soup.

items.name: 3-Item Combo (Brown Basmati)
items.description: Your choice of any three hot curries from our daily counter. Served with nutty whole-grain brown basmati rice, freshly baked bread, and cooling yogurt raita or lentil daal.

menu.shortDesc: Hearty North & West Indian regional classics, stuffed griddled breads, and street comfort food.

items.name: Chana Bhatura
items.description: Slow-simmered Punjabi garbanzo bean curry cooked in black tea and pomegranate seeds, paired with two ballooned, fluffy golden bhaturas, house-pickled carrots, and spicy onions.

items.name: Aloo Poori
items.description: Traditional Delhi-style spiced tomato-potato curry served with two freshly puffed whole wheat pooris, artisanal mango pickle, and spiced yogurt.

items.name: Pav Bhaji
items.description: Mumbai's beloved buttery street curry of slow-mashed vegetables, tomatoes, and house bhaji masala, served with two griddled butter-toasted brioche pav buns.

items.name: Original Wada Pav
items.description: The iconic Mumbai veggie burger: golden batter-fried spiced potato ball nestled inside a warm pav bun, seasoned with spicy red garlic-coconut dry chutney and green chili.

items.name: Stuffed Griddle Paratha
items.description: Freshly hand-rolled whole wheat layered flatbread stuffed with seasoned potatoes or spiced cauliflower, griddled crisp and served with butter, raita, and mixed achar.

items.name: Royal Vegetable Biryani
items.description: Long-grain basmati rice layered with garden vegetables, caramelized onions, saffron milk, whole green cardamom, and cloves, slow cooked 'dum' style.

items.name: Desi Veggie Burger
items.description: Crispy spiced vegetable and potato cutlet layered with lettuce, ripe tomato, sweet onion, and house masala mint mayo on a toasted sesame bun.

menu.shortDesc: Fermented rice & lentil stone-ground batter, griddled paper-thin and served with sambar & coconut dip.

items.name: Crispy Paper Dosa
items.description: Giant, feather-light golden crêpe made from fermented lentil-rice batter. Served with piping hot lentil vegetable stew (sambar) and fresh coconut-curry leaf chutney.

items.name: Classic Masala Dosa
items.description: Crispy fermented rice and lentil crêpe rolled around our signature turmeric-spiced mashed potato and caramelized mustard onion filling. Served with hot sambar and coconut chutney.

items.name: Mysore Masala Dosa
items.description: Signature South Indian crêpe smeared with fiery roasted red chili, garlic, and lentil paste, filled with spiced masala potatoes and roasted cashews.

items.name: Spring Vegetable Dosa
items.description: Thin crispy dosa stuffed with wok-tossed shredded cabbage, bell peppers, carrots, and scallions with mild Indo-Chinese seasoning.

items.name: Onion Chilli Uttapam
items.description: Thick, pillowy fermented rice-lentil pancake embedded with finely chopped sweet red onions and spicy green serrano chilies.

items.name: Tomato Cilantro Uttapam
items.description: Thick savory pancake studded with ripe juicy tomatoes, fragrant cilantro leaves, and cracked cumin seeds.

items.name: Idli Wada Combo Plate
items.description: A pair of cloud-soft steamed savory rice cakes (idli) alongside a crispy golden lentil donut (medu wada), accompanied by warm sambar and coconut chutney.

menu.shortDesc: Refreshing probiotic yogurt smoothies, cooling infused syrups, and freshly steeped spiced masala chai.

items.name: Handcrafted Mango Lassi
items.description: Our bestselling smooth, chilled yogurt drink blended with rich Alphonso mango pulp, green cardamom, and a touch of sweetness.

items.name: 100% Vegan Mango Lassi
items.description: Plant-based indulgence crafted with dairy-free cultured coconut yogurt, sweet mango nectar, and aromatic cardamom.

items.name: Royal Rose Milk
items.description: Delicate and refreshing chilled milk scented with natural Damask rose petal syrup and sweet basil seeds.

items.name: Sweet Cardamom Lassi
items.description: Traditional artisan churned sweet yogurt elixir flavored with fragrant kewra water and freshly ground cardamom.

items.name: Salted Cumin Lassi
items.description: Cooling savory probiotic drink tempered with Himalayan pink rock salt, roasted crushed cumin, and fresh mint leaves.

items.name: Fresh Masala Chai (Small)
items.description: Slow-simmered Assam black tea brewed with fresh crushed ginger root, cracked cardamom pods, cinnamon, and whole milk.

items.name: Fresh Masala Chai (Large)
items.description: Generous 16oz cup of our slow-simmered aromatic masala chai, steeped fresh on the stove all day.

menu.shortDesc: Handcrafted artisanal mithai made fresh with milk fudge, pistachios, saffron, and silver leaf.

items.name: Artisan Mithai (Single Piece)
items.description: Hand-select from our daily glass counter: warm Gulab Jamun, spongy Rasgulla, silver-leaf Kaju Katli, Besan Ladoo, or Pista Peda.

items.name: Gourmet Sweet Box (1 lb)
items.description: One pound custom gift assortment box filled with freshly made traditional Indian sweets of your choice from our bakery case.

items.name: Fresh Saffron Jalebi (1 lb)
items.description: One full pound of freshly piped spiral batter fried golden-crisp and immediately immersed in warm, cardamom and saffron scented sugar syrup.
